title: Retextured Obsidian
description: This resource pack adds a new texture to the Obsidian block, and any related blocks.
body:
This resource pack adds a new texture to the Obsidian block, and any related blocks.

-New Obsidian block Texture

-New Crying Obsidian block Texture

-New Enchanting Table Texture

I found the vanilla Texture to be sharp and in need of an update, so this pack tries to do that.
